{{Quote|He was at Qarshan's game a few years back when Nintellor made that famous bet where he put half his collection on the table.|[[Tavia Kitik]], on [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Winner Lose All">''[[Winner Lose All]]''</ref>}}
'''Qarshan''' was a [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who was active during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He held a card tournament where [[Nintellor]] staked his rare [[Tchine]] statue and several other valuable items.<ref name="Winner Lose All" />
